title: Marion Barry Meets the iPhone Duo
author: John Gruber
summary: Jay Peters, The Verge: The iPhone Duo officially goes on sale today, but a few units already have broken screens. According to posts on Reddit about the affected units, the issue appears to be happening at a similar spot on all of them: Some kind of problem shows up on the inner screen along the hinge and a strange bright line (or lines) across the right side of the display. This crack problem doesn’t seem to be widespread, but it’s seemingly more than a handful.  ★
